description_en: Queries the details of all private custom ApsaraDB RDS instances under a specified PolarDB-X instance
description_zh: 查看目标PolarDB-X实例下所有的私有定制RDS实例详情
name: DescribeDrdsRdsInstances

parameters.help_en:
<props="china">The ID of the PolarDB-X instance.</props>
<props="intl">The ID of the DRDS instance.</props>
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/139284.html to query the details of all instances under the target account, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">PolarDB-X实例ID。</props>
<props="intl">DRDS实例ID。</props>
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/139284.html查看目标账号下所有实例详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: drds_instance_id

DbInstance.description_en: The details of the private custom ApsaraDB RDS instances in the storage layer
DbInstance.description_zh: 存储层私有定制RDS实例信息详情

ConnectUrl.description_en: The internal endpoint of the private custom ApsaraDB RDS instance in the storage layer
ConnectUrl.description_zh: 存储层私有定制RDS实例的内网连接地址

DBInstanceCPU.description_en: The number of CPU cores of the private custom ApsaraDB RDS instance in the storage layer
DBInstanceCPU.description_zh: 存储层私有定制RDS实例的CPU核数

DBInstanceClassType.description_en:
The instance family. Valid values:

x: general-purpose
d: dedicated package
h: dedicated host
DBInstanceClassType.description_zh:
实例规格族，取值范围如下：

x：通用型
d：独享套餐
h：独占物理机

DBInstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the private custom ApsaraDB RDS instance in the storage layer

DBInstanceMemory.description_en: The memory size of the private custom ApsaraDB RDS instance in the storage layer. Unit: MB
DBInstanceMemory.description_zh: 存储层私有定制RDS实例的内存，单位：M

DBInstanceStatus.description_en:
The status of the private custom ApsaraDB RDS instance in the storage layer. Valid values:
0: Being created.
1: Running.
3: Being deleted.
5: Being restarted.
6: Being upgraded or downgraded.
7: Backup in progress.
8: Switching between internal network and public network.
9: Being migrated.
11: Migrating data.
12: Generating a disaster recovery instance.
13: Data import in progress.
14: Importing data from another ApsaraDB RDS instance.
15: Performing a disaster recovery switchover.
16: Creating a temporary instance.
17: Creating a network.
18: Cloning an instance.
19: Switching links.
20: Read-only instance migration in progress
DBInstanceStatus.description_zh:
存储层私有定制RDS实例的状态，取值范围如下：
0：创建中
1：运行中
3：删除中
5：重启中
6：升降级中
7：备份中
8：内外网切换中
9：迁移中
11：迁移数据中
12：生成灾备实例中
13：数据导入中
14：从其他RDS实例导入数据中
15：容灾切换中
16：创建临时实例中
17：网络创建中
18：实例克隆中
19：链路切换中
20：只读实例迁移中

DBInstanceStorage.description_en: The storage capacity of the private custom ApsaraDB RDS instance in the storage layer. Unit: GB
DBInstanceStorage.description_zh: 存储层私有定制RDS实例的存储空间，单位：GB

DbInstType.description_en: The storage layer instance type. The value is fixed as RDS
DbInstType.description_zh: 存储层实例类型，固定为RDS

Engine.description_en: The engine type of the private custom ApsaraDB RDS instance in the storage layer. The value is fixed as MySQL
Engine.description_zh: 存储层私有定制RDS实例的引擎类型，固定为MySQL

EngineVersion.description_en: The DPI engine version number of the private custom ApsaraDB RDS instance in the storage layer. The value is fixed as 8.0
EngineVersion.description_zh: 存储层私有定制RDS实例的引擎版本号，固定为8.0

LockMode.description_en:
The lock status of the ApsaraDB RDS instance. Valid values: 0|1|2|3|4|5

 0: Normal.

1: Manually locked.

2: Automatically locked due to instance expiration.

3: Automatically locked before instance rollback.

4: Automatically locked because the instance storage is full.

5: Automatically locked because the read-only instance storage is full
LockMode.description_zh:
RDS的锁定状态，取值范围：0|1|2|3|4|5

 0，正常

1，手动触发锁

2，实例过期自动锁定

3，实例回滚前的自动锁定

4，实例空间满自动锁定

5，只读实例空间满自动锁定

LockReason.description_en: The reason why the ApsaraDB RDS instance is locked

NetworkType.description_en: The network type of the private custom ApsaraDB RDS instance in the storage layer. The value is fixed as VPC (virtual private cloud)
NetworkType.description_zh: 存储层私有定制RDS实例的网络类型，固定为VPC（专有网络）

PayType.description_en:
The billing method of the private custom ApsaraDB RDS instance in the storage layer. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
Prepaid: subscription
PayType.description_zh:
存储层私有定制RDS实例的付费方式，取值范围如下：

Postpaid：按量付费（即后付费）
Prepaid：包年包月（即预付费）

RdsInstType.description_en:
The type of the private custom ApsaraDB RDS instance in the storage layer. Valid values:

Primary: primary instance
Readonly: read-only instance
RdsInstType.description_zh:
存储层私有定制RDS实例的类型，取值范围如下：

Primary：主实例
Readonly：只读实例

ReadWeight.description_en: The read and write weight of the private custom ApsaraDB RDS instance in the storage layer
ReadWeight.description_zh: 目标存储层私有定制RDS实例的读写权重

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
